bootstrap.interval: BCa 95% preferred; percentile 95% fallback with reason
bootstrap.rng_initialization: Each interval initializes numpy.default_rng with the exact frozen seed 20260820
bootstrap.unit: whole simulationRun or indivisible paired run difference

boundary_sensitivity_interval: Clopper-Pearson exact 95% when events=0 or events=n

h3.micro: secondary only with explicit evidence-item denominator
h3.primary: equal-weight macro mean of applicable run_scores
h3.unsupported_process_claims: qualitative audit only; no frozen automatic rule

llm_confirmation: FIRST_INDICATION_CONCURRENT_FULL_SAMPLE_REFRESH_V1; candidate k ANOMALY confirmed only by ANOMALY at k+4
paired_binary_test: exact two-sided McNemar using discordant pairs
primary_p_value_adjustment: Holm over TARGET confirmed detection and NORMAL confirmed false alarm

secondary_p_value_adjustment.paired_delay_sign_test_family: Holm over raw and confirmed TARGET paired-delay sign tests
secondary_p_value_adjustment.raw_paired_binary_family: Holm over TARGET raw indication and NORMAL raw false alarm

sign_test: exact two-sided binomial, exact-zero ties reported and excluded
